description: Exercises Step 0 of /run-pipeline: additive agentSkills injection from `.claude/pipeline.json`. The seeded config injects android-testing into test-designer, android-testing + android-ui-testing into developer, and android-testing into test-reviewer; architect has NO entry. `/run-pipeline --dry-run` must resolve this and print a SKILLS block WITHOUT reading a spec or dispatching any agent (no spec file is present — a non-dry run would STOP). A correct block proves the command read the new single-file schema, descended into `agentSkills`, routed each project skill to the right agent, and left architect untouched. The grader (check_skills) asserts each injected set matches exactly and architect receives nothing.
